title: SSC GD 2024 Musical Instrument & Musicians PART-1

questions.question: Who of the following was invented and popularized Mohan Veena?
questions.solution:
Pt. Vishwa Mohan Bhatt is the creator and world-renowned exponent of the Mohan Veena.
  • The Mohan Veena is a highly modified archtop guitar that incorporates 20 strings, including melody, drone, and sympathetic strings.
  • Bhatt won a Grammy Award in 1994 for his album A Meeting by the River.
  • Note: The instrument is played with a slide, similar to a Hawaiian steel guitar, but utilizes Indian classical techniques.

questions.question: Who is the first Indian singer to have perform at the Royal Albert Hall in London?
questions.solution:
Lata Mangeshkar, the 'Nightingale of India,' became the first Indian singer to perform at the Royal Albert Hall in London in 1974.
  • This performance was a landmark moment for Indian music on the global stage.
  • She recorded songs in over 36 Indian languages and several foreign languages.
  • Note: She was awarded the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian honor, in 2001.

questions.question: Which instrument is played by the famous music personality Pt. Shiv Kumar Sharma?
questions.solution:
Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma is legendary for playing the Santoor.
  • The Santoor is a trapezoid-shaped hammered dulcimer with 72 strings, originally a folk instrument from Kashmir.
  • He is credited with adapting the instrument for Hindustani Classical music through specialized striking and sliding techniques.

questions.question: This legendary Indian classical flautist is known for his mastery of the bansuri (bamboo flute) and his mesmerizing performances. Who is he?
questions.solution:
Hariprasad Chaurasia is a world-renowned master of the Bansuri (bamboo flute).
  • He belongs to the Maihar Gharana and is known for expanding the expressive possibilities of the North Indian flute.
  • He collaborated with various international musicians and worked extensively in Indian cinema music.

questions.question: Instrumentalist Shiv Kumar Sharma is related to:
questions.solution:
As established, Shiv Kumar Sharma is the musician most synonymous with the Santoor.
  • Before his efforts, the Santoor was primarily used to accompany Sufiana Mausiqi (Sufi music) in the Kashmir Valley.
  • He was awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2001.

questions.question: __________ is a legendary sitar player and one of India's most esteemed classical musicians.
questions.solution:
Pandit Ravi Shankar was a virtuoso Sitar player and a composer who became the most known exponent of North Indian classical music in the 20th century.
  • He was a disciple of Allauddin Khan (founder of the Maihar gharana).
  • He is often credited with introducing Indian classical music to the Western world, notably influencing The Beatles.

questions.question: Pt. Ravi Shankar, Shahid Parvez Khan, Budhaditya Mukherjee, Anushka Shankar, are associated with ___________.
questions.solution:
Pt. Ravi Shankar, Shahid Parvez Khan, Budhaditya Mukherjee, and Anushka Shankar are all legendary exponents of the Sitar.
  • The Sitar is a plucked stringed instrument used in Hindustani classical music, known for its long neck and gourd resonator.
  • Additional Info: Shahid Parvez represents the Etawah Gharana, known for its vocalistic (gayaki ang) style of playing.

questions.question: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia, is a world-renowned exponent of the
questions.solution:
Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is the most famous practitioner of the Bansuri.
  • He began his musical journey as a vocalist before switching to the flute under the guidance of Bholanath Prasanna and later Annapurna Devi.

questions.question: With what musical instrument is Ustad Binda Khan associated?
questions.solution:
Ustad Binda Khan was a maestro of the Sarangi.
  • The Sarangi is a bowed, short-necked string instrument often described as being the closest to the sound of the human voice.
  • Binda Khan was a member of the Delhi Gharana and wrote a significant book on music theory titled Abhinav Sarangi Manjari.

questions.question: Amjad Ali Khan is music exponent of __________.
questions.solution:
Amjad Ali Khan is a preeminent master of the Sarod.
  • The Sarod is a fretless string instrument with a skin-covered body and a polished steel fretboard.
  • He represents the sixth generation in a legendary lineage of Sarod players known as the Bangash family.

questions.question: Shakoor Khan and Pt. Ram Narayan are associated with which musical instrument?
questions.solution:
Shakoor Khan and Pt. Ram Narayan are two of the most significant figures associated with the Sarangi.
  • Pt. Ram Narayan is widely credited with bringing the Sarangi to global status as a solo concert instrument.
  • Shakoor Khan was a prominent musician of the Kirana Gharana.

questions.question: Asad Ali Khan is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
questions.solution:
Asad Ali Khan was one of the few remaining masters of the Rudra Veena.
  • The Rudra Veena is a large, ancient plucked string instrument associated with the Dhrupad style of music.
  • He was an exponent of the Khandarbani school of playing.

questions.question: Which maestro of the tabla, a percussion instrument, is regarded as one of the greatest musicians in the world and has collaborated with numerous international artists?
questions.solution:
Ustad Zakir Hussain is the world-famous maestro of the Tabla.
  • The Tabla consists of a pair of hand drums (the smaller Dayan and larger Bayan).
  • He is a child prodigy and the son of Ustad Allah Rakha, known for his incredible speed and technical precision.

questions.question:
Which of the following is correctly matched with respected to the persons and related to their musical instruments?

I. U Srinivas — Mandolin

II. Bismillah Khan — Shehnai
questions.solution:
Both statements are correct:
  • U Srinivas: Often called 'Mandolin Srinivas,' he was a child prodigy who adapted the Mandolin (an electric Western instrument) for Carnatic music.
  • Bismillah Khan: The legendary maestro who elevated the Shehnai to the concert stage and was awarded the Bharat Ratna.

questions.question:
Which of the following pair is correctly matched in context of person and related to their musical instrument?

I. Totaram Sharma — Pakhawaj

Il. Zakir Hussain — Flute
questions.solution:
Only Statement I is correct.
  • Totaram Sharma is a renowned master of the Pakhawaj (a barrel-shaped, two-headed drum).
  • Zakir Hussain is a Tabla player, not a flute player (that would be Hariprasad Chaurasia).

questions.question: Which of the following has invented the musical instrument Bamhum and Tikzik?
questions.solution:
Moa Subong is an inventive musician from Nagaland who created the Bamhum (a bamboo wind instrument) and the Tikzik (a percussion instrument).
  • He is the founder of the folk-fusion band Abiogenesis.
  • He was awarded the Padma Shri in 2023 for his contribution to art and innovation.

questions.question: Which of the following musicians have won the Dada Saheb Phalke Award?
questions.solution:
Gulzar (Sampooran Singh Kalra) won the Dadasaheb Phalke Award in 2013.
  • While he is primarily a lyricist, poet, and director, he is an integral part of the Indian music industry.
  • Note: The Dadasaheb Phalke Award is India's highest award in the field of cinema.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT associated with musical instrument Sarangi?
questions.solution:
Nikhil Banerjee is not associated with the Sarangi; he was one of the greatest Sitar players of the 20th century.
  • The other three (Binda Khan, Ramesh Mishra, and Shakoor Khan) are all celebrated Sarangi players.
  • Nikhil Banerjee belonged to the Maihar Gharana.

questions.question: Zakir Hussain is famous for:
questions.solution:
Zakir Hussain is internationally famous for playing the Tabla.
  • He has played a key role in making the Tabla a lead instrument in world music collaborations, such as with the band Shakti.

questions.question: Who was founder of the Agra Gharana?
questions.solution:
Khuda Baksh is regarded as the founder of the Agra Gharana.
  • The Agra Gharana is known for its powerful, deep vocal style and its roots in the Nauhar Bani of Dhrupad.
  • It is famous for the use of Nom-Tom alap and rhythmic playfulness.

questions.question: Haddu khan and Hassu Khan were regarded as great masters of which style?
questions.solution:
Haddu Khan and Hassu Khan were the pioneers of the Khyal style of singing within the Gwalior Gharana.
  • Khyal (meaning 'imagination') is a modern genre of classical singing that allows for more freedom and improvisation than the older Dhrupad style.
  • Gwalior is considered the 'mother' of all Khyal gharanas.

questions.question: Who of the following was famous for Punjabi folk song and for singing a long breathless alaap?
questions.solution:
Gurmeet Bawa was a legendary Punjabi folk singer known for her long hekh (a long, breathless opening note or alaap).
  • She was famously known as 'Lambi Hek di Rani' (The Queen of Long Breath).
  • She played a vital role in preserving traditional Punjabi folk music instruments like the Alghoza.

questions.question: Which Indian personality is known as the Mozart of Madras?
questions.solution:
A.R. Rahman is famously known as the 'Mozart of Madras'.
  • He is a world-class composer, singer, and music producer who won two Academy Awards (Oscars) for the film Slumdog Millionaire.
  • He is credited with revolutionizing the sound of Indian film music by integrating electronic music with classical arrangements.

questions.question: Pannalal Ghosh is famous for which musical instrument?
questions.solution:
Pannalal Ghosh (also known as Amal Jyoti Ghosh) was a pioneer of the Flute (Bansuri).
  • He is credited with introducing the large bass flute into Hindustani classical music to achieve lower octaves.
  • He was a disciple of Ustad Allauddin Khan.

questions.question: Which musical instrument is played by Pt. Ravi Shankar?
questions.solution:
Pt. Ravi Shankar is synonymous with the Sitar.
  • The Sitar features a long neck with 20 metal frets and 6-7 main strings, along with 11-13 sympathetic strings that vibrate to create a shimmering sound.
